responsibility: This header provides the C++ wrapper layer for GCC’s standalone libdiagnostics C API. In namespace `libdiagnostics` it defines lightweight wrapper and RAII classes for diagnostic managers, text sinks, files, physical and logical locations, execution paths, diagnostic groups, and in-progress diagnostics, forwarding operations such as sink configuration, location creation, group scoping, fix-it attachment, execution-path construction, and final emission to the underlying `libdiagnostics.h` functions while giving C++ clients ownership-safe move/destructor behavior and more natural method-based use.
